description: Departing flights of the security filters case (16/07/2008 to 31/07/2008), with the airlines and the airports. One record per operated flight, except the flights in 'excluded_flights'. All the flights depart from the airport in 'origin'. Times are scheduled departure times (STD), in local time at the origin airport.

flights.id: Identifier of the record in this file (F0001, F0002...)
flights.flight_number: Flight number as given in the original data
flights.airline: ICAO code of the airline: the first three letters of the flight number
flights.origin: IATA code of the airport the flight departs from
flights.std: Scheduled time of departure (HH:MM), local time at the origin airport
flights.destination: IATA code of the destination airport
flights.seats: Number of seats of the aircraft on that flight
